dialogues.npc_text: Aha! A new face... What brings you to this forsaken place?

player_choices.response: I am just an old man with many stories to tell.
I have a quest for you, if you are willing.Of course, it's not free. I have something to thank you for. So what do you say?

next_choices.response: Nearby in the forest there is a laboratory where I conducted alchemical experiments. With the invasion of hell beasts, I left it in a hurry. I forgot one important thing there. Could you bring it to me?
Nothing special. Magic crystal. It looks like an ordinary glass ball. I'll be waiting for your return.
I see, come back when you're ready.
All right, come back when you're ready.

player_choices.response: The opening of the ancient portals led to dire consequences. A huge number of dangerous creatures escaped from the afterlife and now our peaceful and carefree life has come to an end.

quest1.name: Find Lost Magic Crystal
quest1.description: Find the Old Man's lost magic globe near his laboratory on the tree house in the dormant forest.

objectives.name: Find the Magic Crystal
objectives.description: Locate the crystal in the Old Man's laboratory.

objectives.name: Deliver the Magic Crystal
objectives.description: Return the Magic Crystal to the Old Man.

next_choices.text: Where should I look for that crystal?
next_choices.response: Head west (right) until you come across giant trees blocking the sun. This is a dormant forest. The magic ball should be hidden somewhere near the tree house.

player_choices.response: I am just an old man with many stories to tell.
I have a quest for you, if you are willing.

dialogues.npc_text: I have a task for you. Will you accept it?

player_choices.text: Yes, what do I need to do?
player_choices.response: Go to the forest and retrieve the Magic Crystal.
